The type of changes you want to perform on your budget. Enum values: `UPDATE`: To update the budget mode and budget amount. If you set this field to `UPDATE`, pass in `advertiser_id`, `budget`, and optionally `budget_mode` within the `advertiser_budgets` object. `RESET`: To reset the budget consumption of the ad account or ad accounts to 0.You can only reset the budget consumption of an ad account with a custom budget (`budget_mode` is `CUSTOM_BUDGET`).If you set this field to `RESET`, only `advertiser_id` within the `advertiser_budgets` object is required, and `budget_mode` and `budget`, if passed, will be ignored.`INCREMENTAL_UPDATE`: To add to or deduct from the current ad account budget. `ONE_CLICK_SET`: To set the ad account budget to the minimum amount. You don't need to specify the `budget` within the `advertiser_budgets` object array. You can obtain the budget after the change from the response parameter `one_click_set_amount`. | `request_id` | `body` | `string` | No | No | Valid only when `budget_update_type` is `INCREMENTAL_UPDATE`. Request ID. This field supports idempotency to prevent you from sending the same request twice. If you retry requests with the same request ID multiple times, then only one will succeed. It is different from the `request_id` returned in the response parameters, which is used to uniquely identify an HTTP request. The value should be a 32-bit string, with idempotency guaranteed for a 30-minute window. Example: `123456789`. Note: Idempotency for incremental ad account budget updates using `request_id` is currently an allowlist-only feature. If you would like to access it, please contact your TikTok representative. |
| `advertiser_budgets` | `body` | `Array<AdvertiserUpdateParamsAdvertiserBudgets>` | No | No | Required when `bc_id` is passed. Information about the new budget settings of one or more ad accounts. Max size: When `budget_update_type` is `UPDATE` or `RESET`: 50.When `budget_update_type` is `INCREMENTAL_UPDATE` or `ONE_CLICK_SET`: 1. Note: The monthly budget, daily budget, and custom budget of each ad account can be updated up to 20 times a calendar day. |
